entities.summary: Marek Szwarc was a painter and sculptor associated with the School of Paris, as well as with the Yiddish cultural avant-garde movement in Poland Yung-yidish. Marek Szwarc was a painters & sculptors from Zgierz (1892-05-09, Zgierz–1958-12-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
